description:
Pegma brings the legendary Peg Solitaire puzzle right to your mobile device! Jump pegs over each other to clear the board and leave only one — sounds easy, but it’s a real brain-teaser!

Enjoy a clean, modern interface, smooth gameplay, and multiple board layouts. Whether you’re a casual player or a puzzle master, Pegma will keep your brain engaged and entertained.

Pegma is completely free and open source — no ads, no hidden purchases, just pure puzzle fun!
promotionalText: Discover the pure challenge of the classic Peg Solitaire — free, open source, and fun to master!
